log.message: init bootstrap startup exits after configuration lookup

rationale: The archived startup family overlaps lexically, but the bootstrap stage points to the init-container diagnosis.

log.message: container startup failed before the application ran

rationale: Several startup failures share the same words; the pre-start configuration event identifies configuration resolution.

log.message: pending Redis stream events are not acknowledged while the outbox publisher is blocked

rationale: Both runbooks involve pending Redis stream work; the publisher and outbox context distinguish this from recovery of idle consumer entries.

facts.event_message: promotion blocked by server-side apply field-manager conflict

rationale: Both delivery controls can block promotion, while the field-manager conflict belongs to the ArgoCD reconciliation path.

log.message: Redis restarted and the available geo index is empty while matching requests remain pending

rationale: Redis and pending work are shared symptoms; the lost geographic availability index is specific to driver matching.

log.message: idle pending stream entries are reclaimed after a worker restart but acknowledgement never completes

rationale: The queue symptoms overlap with an outbox backlog; reclaiming idle consumer entries makes the consumer-group failure distinct.

log.message: pending offer is cancelled at the ten second deadline while no driver responds

rationale: Pending dispatch work overlaps the idle-consumer recovery candidate, but the fixed offer deadline identifies the timeout worker behaviour.

facts.event_message: resource request and node taint prevent the pending pod from scheduling

rationale: Both candidates have pending work, but the scheduler event and changed resource request identify placement failure.

log.message: application startup fails because an endpoint configuration value is missing

configuration.diff: payments env REQUIRED_ENDPOINT removed in the last deployment

rationale: A crash loop is the visible Kubernetes symptom, but log and deployment diff jointly identify a missing runtime configuration value.

log.message: database migration init task loads the full catalog into memory

configuration.diff: initContainer memory limit reduced for catalog

rationale: Both OOM diagnoses share the termination signal; the migration init task and its limit distinguish the init-container path.

facts.event_message: startup cannot retrieve the requested image

log.message: deployment startup remains blocked before the application container is created

configuration.diff: checkout image tag changed to registry.example.invalid/checkout:green

rationale: A pre-start failure can resemble configuration resolution, but the invalid image reference and pull status identify the registry path.

facts.event_message: deployment scaled from three replicas to zero

log.message: no pods are available to accept search traffic

configuration.diff: search HPA minReplicas changed from 3 to 0

rationale: No serving pods can also result from scheduling failure, while the replica-scale event and HPA diff directly identify intentional scale-to-zero.

facts.event_message: promotion stopped after an AnalysisRun latency regression

log.message: analysis run reports error rate and p99 latency above the promotion threshold

rationale: A live error-rate alert can co-occur with delivery verification, but the failed AnalysisRun and threshold change identify the promotion-control diagnosis.

log.message: startup request to the ride dependency returns a connection error

rationale: Startup language and a deployment change also fit configuration resolution, but the running application repeatedly restarts after its dependency connection fails.

log.message: worker reports pending work after a restart

rationale: This deliberately sparse stress case keeps the candidates ambiguous; pending work after restart most closely matches recovery of idle consumer entries.

facts.event_message: application container restarts after dependency connection failure

log.message: startup connection to profile database is refused

configuration.diff: profile database host changed in deployment values

rationale: The data has a configuration change and startup failure, yet the repeatedly restarting application container—not a pre-start resolver or init task—is the diagnosed failure.
